results.title: Joey Logano wins NASCAR Cup race at Richmond, and guess who's back, back again
results.description: Logano, in danger of missing the playoffs a few weeks ago, is suddenly looking like a title contender after another strong performance.

results.title: Messi sees penalty saved as Nashville routs Inter Miami in MLS
results.description: Lionel Messi missed yet another penalty and was booked as Inter Miami suffered a 4-1 loss at Nashville on Saturday in a top-of-the-table MLS clash.Nashville leads MLS with 43 points and a record of 13-2 with four drawn while Inter Miami are second on 38 points.

Spain Break Australia's Historic Milestone, Add To Country's Sporting Legacy
results.description: Spain broke Australia's long-standing record in international cricket to add to the country's sporting legacy. Spain achieved the milestone less than a month after their football team won the World Cup.

results.title: Brewers DFA Jihwan Bae, acquire Jonathan Ornelas from A's; Brice Turang update
results.description: The Brewers acquired Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for middle infield depth.

results.title: Kate Douglass storms to another 50 free world record, winning Pan Pacs in 23.19
results.description: IRVINE, Calif. (AP) — Kate Douglass lowered her own world record in the women’s 50-meter freestyle for the second time Saturday, winning the Pan Pacific Championships final in 23.19 seconds.
